title: Simplify to Class-10 reading level
promptText:
Simplify the technical / policy text below so a Class-10 educated citizen or junior field staff member can understand it.

Goals:
- Keep all mandatory safety and compliance meaning intact.
- Replace jargon with plain language; where a technical term must stay, add a short plain explanation in parentheses.
- Short sentences. Active voice. No metaphors.
- Prefer bullet lists for steps, warnings, and do/don't items.
- Do not invent new rules, voltages, distances, or penalties.
- If something is ambiguous in the source, write [VERIFY] instead of guessing.

Output format:
1. One-sentence plain summary
2. Key points (bullets)
3. What citizens / staff must do
4. What they must not do

SOURCE TEXT:
[Paste circular, SOP excerpt, or technical note]
